title: Aava: an open world that comes alive as you build in it
description:
A 3D exploration and building game for children, written in GDScript on Godot 4. The valley is generated from a single integer seed, so the ground itself costs nothing to store or to send; everything a child builds makes it more alive, and the more alive it is the more it gives back.

It is played on a phone, by two brothers aged ten and six, and nearly every change in its history began as one of them saying what looked wrong. Its checks are written the same way: each one corresponds to a bug that actually happened.

The code is AGPL-3.0-or-later. The name Aava, the application id and the icon are reserved and are not covered by that licence; see NOTICE.md.
